description: List invitation state for one OWNED job (proposal_management.job_invitations.list) from canonical Joboffer INVITE rows. State is HIRED (accepted linked proposal) > APPLIED (linked proposal) > DECLINED > INVITED — there is NO expired state and no expiry is ever fabricated; hireAcceptancePending is true only while a REAL live hire authorization awaits the candidate. Hidden, banned, or closed candidates are withheld from the page AND totalCount; optional freelancerId/state filters apply BEFORE the exact count and the newest-first keyset cursor (pass nextCursor to continue). Identity is masked (first name + last initial, slug, country). structuredContent IS the raw validated page. Requires proposals:read scope, the hiring feature, and employer access to the job; the proposal_management family is DEFAULT-OFF (AGENT_SURFACE_PROPOSAL_MANAGEMENT_ENABLED) and a disabled family is a typed 403 AGENT_SURFACE_DISABLED.

freelancerId.description: Optional exact candidate filter (applied before count and cursor).

state.description: Optional derived-state filter (applied before count and cursor).

name: opentrain_list_job_invitations
